title: When the list of app members fails to load, a group message from the assistant still sends, skips the app and calls every member 'without the app'
what: The assistant loads who has the member app when it opens. If that load fails (for example a weak line), the message card only says the app list could not load, but Send still works and still takes the credit. For a group, nobody gets the message in the app or as a push; every member in the group is put on the WhatsApp list, and the result line says 'Sent to 0 in the app. N members without the app are ready on WhatsApp', which is wrong for members who do have the app. For 'everyone', the app message goes out and the whole gym is also put on the WhatsApp list, so app members get it twice.
expected: While the app list is missing, Send waits (or tries the load again) and the card says the message cannot go yet; the result line never calls app members 'without the app'.
how_often: sometimes: only when the app list did not load
fix_line: Block Send and reload the app list when it is missing

title: Changing the plan on the assistant's add-member card keeps the old joining fee, or none
what: When the owner asks the assistant to add a member, the card fills in the plan's price and joining fee. If the owner then picks a different plan on the card, only the price changes; the joining fee stays at what the first plan had. If the assistant found no plan and the owner picks one, the joining fee stays at zero. The card shows one total price with no fee line, and the checks allow it for the owner, so a member can be saved owing a wrong joining fee.
expected: Picking a plan on the card sets both the price and that plan's joining fee, the same as the normal Add member screen.
how_often: every time the plan is changed on the card
fix_line: Set the joining fee from the newly picked plan when the plan changes
